summary: Solana Holland breeds, produces and sells seed potatoes, using classic breeding only, from its head office and breeding station in Emmeloord, the Netherlands. The company started in 1937 and has been part of the Solana Group since 1987. Its seed is grown by selected producers on clay soil.
ownership: Part of the Solana Group since 1987
products: Seed potatoes for crisps, flakes and French fries
